claims: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half took place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half had over 30,000 finishers.
The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half was recorded as the largest half-marathon in New York Road Runners (NYRR) history.
Adriaan Wildschutt (South Africa) won the men's division of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half in 59:30.
Adriaan Wildschutt's time of 59:30 marked the second-fastest debut time in the event's history.
Hellen Obiri (Kenya) won the women's division of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half in 1:06:33.
Hellen Obiri set a new course record of 1:06:33 in the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half.
Hellen Obiri won her second NYC Half title.
Eden Rainbow-Cooper (Great Britain) won the women's wheelchair title of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half in 54:27.
Daniel Romanchuk (USA) won the men's wheelchair title of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half in 48:10.
